name: game speed: the ladder, the pause, and the corners that drive them

steps.note: a map opens running at 1x, with a crowd to watch
+ and - walk the ladder, and say so in the log

steps.shot: at the top of the ladder

steps.note: and it stops at the top rather than wrapping round to the bottom
p pauses, and the button beside the readout offers to resume
a paused world does not advance, however long the game runs
...and something spawned while it is paused still appears
letting go of the pause goes back to the speed being watched
the corner buttons do what the keys do, addressed by name
asking for a speed lets go of the pause rather than doing nothing
a gamepad reaches all of it too: bumpers for speed, Y for pause
+ and - are the speed's now, so they must not also zoom
the zoom is the other corner, on its own buttons

steps.shot: zoomed in from the corner, at half speed

steps.note: and q/e still zoom without touching the speed
menu leaves the game, exactly as escape does
a game left at half speed opens the next one at 1x, running
